content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NRTC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for NRTC Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 10 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they arrive at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the maximum age limit for the posts advertised by NRTC?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts advertised by the National Research & Technology Consortium is 45 years.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the NRTC recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification ranges from Matriculation with ITI Certificate to Master's degrees in various disciplines, as specified for each post.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available in the NRTC recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies available for various posts under the Expression of Interest by the National Research & Technology Consortium.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for the NRTC recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Interested candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the positions at NRTC?
faq.answer: The salaries for the positions range from Rs. 15,240/- to Rs. 48,700/- per month, depending on the post and qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the NRTC walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry original documents and self-attested copies of certificates related to qualification, age, and experience, along with a passport-size photograph.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for NRTC recruitment being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the National Research & Technology Consortium, Sector 1 office premises, Parwanoo, Himachal Pradesh, 173220.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the NRTC Expression of Interest posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an evaluation of academic records, relevant experience, and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for the NRTC recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the available information, there is no application fee mentioned for the NRTC recruitment drive.
